item: R854 row 409 stage 4d: the erase sweep covers the segment recovery copies folder
summary: Before any code can create it, the panic erase sweeps <data>/corpus/recovery: each leftover torn-segment recovery copy (seg-N.check.db and its journal) gets page 1 randomised in the key-material pass, never capped (R797), then is rewritten whole and unlinked; a copy is never evidence of encryption, whatever its header, name or folder (R823/R820); counted as recovery_copies, never named (R806); anything else in the folder, a link at its name, or a copy with a second name is left and counted; app-only scope reaches a copy only beside a segment the record names (R711); the uninstall watcher refuses a hard-linked copy; the folder is never a segment and no backup, export or bundle module reaches the corpus folder (source guard).
